content: विलासिन् {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) Sportive, playful, dallying, wanton, coquettish; विस्रस्तमंसादपरो विलासी <ls>R. 6. 14</ls>. --{%m.%} .²1 A sensualist, voluptuary, an amorous person; उपमानमभूद्विलासिनां करणं यत्तव कान्तिमत्तया <ls>Ku. 4. 5</ls>. .²2 Fire. .²3 The moon. .²4 A snake. .²5 An epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu. .²6 Of Śiva. .²7 Of the god of love.
